programme.desc: 佐敦与丽闹翻，亨回印度的事不了了之。亨向丽勒索，更令人误会二人拍拖。丽向亨表示凡知道她富有的人三日内必定会意外死去，亨接连遇上怪事，往找丽求救。丽道出唯有说服其他人相信这个秘密，从而将诅咒转移给那人。

programme.title: 天龙八部#26粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹回少林寺，灵鹫宫四姑娘暗中跟随。哲罗星与清凉寺方丈来到少林寺，要求少林寺释放波罗星。少林寺则指波罗星偷学少林武功。期间鸠摩智前来挑战少林众长老，虚竹见状还击，却暴露了自己身上的逍遥派武功…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷、阿谭一试压制虾膏，兼以大澳出产的靓虾酱蒸煮猪板筋，以烈酒腌猪肉有何作用？食材摆放次序原来足以影响菜式质素；再用虾膏带来「虾酱啫啫生菜」，简单易做。主持们在南海盐步搜罗各式茄子，见识特产秋茄的种植过程。二人制作「茹香茄子」迎合绿色星期一，以腐乳代替咸鱼，不失原材料的精髓，色香味俱全！另一道「清炒素五子」够健康，为何果仁需分开汆水？新鲜雪耳属时令食材，但无有怕，选用干雪耳亦可炒出鲜味。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 女性于更年期后因雌激素下降，患心血管疾病的风险大增。心脏科医生指男女的心脏病发的症状大有分别，女士如出现上背痛、上腹痛便要提高警觉。通波仔手术是心脏病的主流治疗，部份女患者却未必适合，有何原因？区瑞强、周国丰、郑子诚三位资深DJ将首次合作开骚，他们惺惺相惜，私下情谊深厚。国丰笑言担心唱歌时忘记歌词；子诚亦坦言对唱歌感忧虑，并感谢区瑞强的窝心支援。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「鱼香茄子肉碎」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 有没有一家店可一次过品尝东莞各地区的美食？在万江区，本集探店的这家酒楼就可以满足你，不仅如此，内里还附设一个甚具规模的东莞饮食风俗博物馆！大饱口福之后，祖蓝还带大家去「料」(玩)，行逛一个历史文化古村— 下坝坊，这里并不简单，游人于白天可以感受百年古镇的风情，夜晚就大变身，成为年轻人最爱「蒲」之地……

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#5粤
programme.desc: 兆明请员工吃蛋挞，威龙替他说好话，秀琼诧异。兆明约司徒岚参加莎莎舞之夜；窦彰亦答应德正一同参加莎莎舞活动。司徒岚在舞会忽见秀琼出现，她要兆明回避。德正与柯美娜跳舞期间见到秀琼，即找兆明掩饰。六人同坐一桌，司徒岚苦思如何收拾残局。秀琼前往拜祭亡夫，司徒岚要秀琼忆述父亲救人牺牲经过。俊男向司徒岚送花示爱，司徒岚表示已有男朋友，窦彰误会司徒岚认定自己是其男友。威龙等车时见到晓盈喝醉，邓勤送她回家……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: 万理忆述自己与千相识并组织乐队的经过，因为多次与其他成员发生冲突，万理劝千放弃自己演奏，改为专心唱歌和加入舞蹈，令Re:vale获得成功。当时的百随姊姊去看Re:vale的演唱会，瞬间深受感动。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 菠萝油是香港代表食品之一，子健哥哥从其香脆可口的外皮动笔，示范怎样画出这款港式美食。此外，不少人还爱配以冻柠檬茶一并享用，组合成茶餐厅的经典套餐。本集「Artspiration」带领观众了解个中绘画技巧，其间Emily姐姐亦分享她制作面包的经历。小朋友投稿「我最爱的玩具」，有孩子绘画了铁道火车，勾起玲玲姐姐童年玩蒸汽火车模型的美好回忆。也有小朋友介绍自己的心爱毛公仔，主持姐姐亦忆述儿时的公仔玩伴。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 千依突然要求加入Secret Friends，跟阳葵等人一起练习，但是，当她知道练习内容跟人气萤光幻彩变身没有关系，便立即宣布退出。千依对人气萤光幻彩变身这份执著，背后隐藏著的，正是她不为人知的过去。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 宝林一个居屋三房单位，设计利用大地色系，营造温馨感觉，最终效果如何？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2763粤
programme.desc: 壮、Elaine与Venus被力莲抽中，负责筹办春茗。壮与Venus本想偷懒，打算沿用往年流程，Elaine却用心构思新项目，获力莲赞赏；因Elaine过于投入，壮与Venus亦被迫加倍努力，因此疲于奔命。壮尝试劝Elaine不要太落力，却不果。Venus暗中「搞破坏」，Elaine意外识破此事，并得知壮亦不认同自己……春茗当天，众人期待享用佳肴、抽获名贵礼品，以及欣赏巨星演出，但却大失所望……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#15粤PG
programme.desc: 妙姿先宗南一步前往奕风家，处理了可证明奕风协助学年逃脱的物品。步青往找佳琪，请求她帮忙调查奕风。学年被踢出四联商会，刘彪重返四联，并接管车仔化工的业务。学年跟踪刘彪、索帕，发现奕风与索帕会面。学年绑走奕风，当得知奕风是助世豪对付刘彪，表示可提供协助。佳琪发现刘彪和丽荃的暧昧行径，终证实二人偷情。妙姿拿到嘉盈的电脑，找小茹帮忙解码；其后，电脑却出现在奕风手上……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#7粤普PG
programme.desc: 瑾瑜醉酒说心口疼，令楚楚想到什么，复验神观尸体后发现他是中毒而亡。景翊府中遭贼，冷月推测贼人是为花而来，众人分析后锁定森垚。景翊把森垚带到瑾瑜面前套话，森垚终说出是听从鬼差的话，给神观喝了下了药的茶。

programme.title: 中国建设银行(亚洲)呈献：攻你上大学粤
programme.desc: 中三考题开正《中年好声音》众人的「音乐专业」，有人豪言答错即引退！「褶曲作用」的地貌考起大家，文静老师更畀山埃贴士？中五公民与社会发展题，某君趣谈「软硬理论」，令Bob教授都难以招架！大学领域难度升级，「优异生」二话不说将滴定管题目送给对手。模仿有助解读接吻鱼行为？终极两强以物理学「重力奇异点」知识对决，被「钦点」答题者却分析得似层层，可望转危为机。音乐巨作成赢「奖学金」关卡，哼得出都未必识答……

programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#23粤
programme.desc: 赵穆宴请董匡，突指他是冒牌货，少龙吓一跳。琴清与少龙在花园相遇，少龙放出捉来的萤火虫，无数萤火虫围著琴清飞舞令她惊叹。赵穆秘密去祭山鬼，少龙计划利用一线天的天险生擒赵穆。琴清邀少龙游湖画画，少龙灵机一动将琴清的水墨画改为彩墨画，琴清喜出望外。回程时琴清扭伤脚，由少龙抱回府。滕翼责少龙错过生擒赵穆的机会，少龙愧疚。琴清再约少龙游湖，却惊见赵穆出现，却被幪面黑衣人偷袭就擒，琴清扯下黑衣人面巾及假胡子。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 女性于更年期后因雌激素下降，患心血管疾病的风险大增。心脏科医生指男女的心脏病发的症状大有分别，女士如出现上背痛、上腹痛便要提高警觉。通波仔手术是心脏病的主流治疗，部份女患者却未必适合，有何原因？区瑞强、周国丰、郑子诚三位资深DJ将首次合作开骚，他们惺惺相惜，私下情谊深厚。国丰笑言担心唱歌时忘记歌词；子诚亦坦言对唱歌感忧虑，并感谢区瑞强的窝心支援。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「鱼香茄子肉碎」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在东莞粤
programme.desc: 有没有一家店可一次过品尝东莞各地区的美食？在万江区，本集探店的这家酒楼就可以满足你，不仅如此，内里还附设一个甚具规模的东莞饮食风俗博物馆！大饱口福之后，祖蓝还带大家去「料」(玩)，行逛一个历史文化古村— 下坝坊，这里并不简单，游人于白天可以感受百年古镇的风情，夜晚就大变身，成为年轻人最爱「蒲」之地……

programme.title: 高朋满座#53粤
programme.desc: 佐敦与丽闹翻，亨回印度的事不了了之。亨向丽勒索，更令人误会二人拍拖。丽向亨表示凡知道她富有的人三日内必定会意外死去，亨接连遇上怪事，往找丽求救。丽道出唯有说服其他人相信这个秘密，从而将诅咒转移给那人。

programme.title: 天龙八部#26粤普PG
programme.desc: 虚竹回少林寺，灵鹫宫四姑娘暗中跟随。哲罗星与清凉寺方丈来到少林寺，要求少林寺释放波罗星。少林寺则指波罗星偷学少林武功。期间鸠摩智前来挑战少林众长老，虚竹见状还击，却暴露了自己身上的逍遥派武功…

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 压轴一集，大妈们在社区会堂跳着熟练舞步，对宠物、表演、食物相关歇后语又有多少认识？俗语「豆泥」源自糕点馅料；「苏虾仔」正写是「苏孲崽」，大学讲师廖舜禧逐一解构。三位主持和黄建东在怀旧士多「寻宝」，竟分别互称表兄妹，究竟搞边科？「摩罗街雨褛－ 过底」有何喻意？掌故专家郑宝鸿并讲解摩罗街叫摩罗街的原因。主持们走进果栏了解「发财丁」、「坐车」等行内术语；还向毛冷舖店主请教不同毛冷的质地及保存毛衣方法。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统金器手工精巧，现代机器难以取代。主持人来到金舖欣赏各款名贵首饰，期间竟有人被称呼为「石狗公」，有何所指？花生糖保持古法人手炮制，昔日风味得以保存。麦美恩亲自拜师学习做糖，顺道细谈「石地板种花生」、「发霉花生」等歇后语。「老细」、「事头」何以成为上司代名词？且听中文讲师廖舜禧拆解。粤语逾二千年来原来甚少演变，故被视为古汉语「活化石」。廖舜禧追溯广府话历史，还从「锡」「勼」「冧」三字解构爱情真义！

programme.title: 检索爱情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X张基龙大谈姐弟恋年下男狂撩职场女强人】聚焦于三位35岁女性——裴朵美、车贤和宋佳景，她们在职场和感情中勇敢追梦。这三位独立的女性，专注于自己的事业，成为职场上的佼佼者。然而在她们坚强的外表下，深藏著对爱情的渴望。尽管在追求梦想的道路上充满坎坷，她们依然坚信自己的抉择。在她们身后都有一位，用自己的方式默默守护的真命天子，以现实的笔触描绘了这三个女性在职场上的竞争和情感中的纠结，将粉红泡泡与现实的辛酸完美结合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇(完)
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 检索爱情
programme.desc: 【林秀晶X张基龙大谈姐弟恋年下男狂撩职场女强人】聚焦于三位35岁女性——裴朵美、车贤和宋佳景，她们在职场和感情中勇敢追梦。这三位独立的女性，专注于自己的事业，成为职场上的佼佼者。然而在她们坚强的外表下，深藏著对爱情的渴望。尽管在追求梦想的道路上充满坎坷，她们依然坚信自己的抉择。在她们身后都有一位，用自己的方式默默守护的真命天子，以现实的笔触描绘了这三个女性在职场上的竞争和情感中的纠结，将粉红泡泡与现实的辛酸完美结合。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. The Squirrels take an epic journey to give it back.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Solar E-Glitch
programme.desc: After watching a solar eclipse, the team head into space to fix the biggest glitch yet!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Fancy Restaurant
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey want mum and dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan, until chef Bingo's special arrives.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures (S1) - Andy and the Sea Kraits
programme.desc: Andy blasts off in his sub to find out where snakes called sea kraits lay their eggs.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Tubes
programme.desc: Bella and Lift enjoy making funny honk noises with tubes. They visit Tincy the Spider, who uses terrific tubes to make music with the Playtimers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Cinema Badge
programme.desc: Before the Squirrels attend the cinema for the first time, Duggee teaches them that there are rules they need to follow.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Difficult Badge
programme.desc: As the Squirrels appreciate Norrie's new bike, they discover that she doesn't know how to ride it, she finds it too difficult.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The News Badge
programme.desc: After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Paddy Fields of China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters swing into action when they discover that Glitch is using real landmarks for his crazy golf course.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Nazca Lines, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - James the Super Engine
programme.desc: When James hears the children of Sodor talking about their latest comic book superhero, he imagines that he too can become a hero.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Perimeter Pals
programme.desc: Sarah, Duck & Bug set off on a big adventure, through uncharted territory, as they attempt to cycle all the way around the park.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Castle Scribbling
programme.desc: Whilst visiting a Castle, Sarah & Duck's drawings lead them to an exciting discovery.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - House
programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Snug as a Bug
programme.desc: A series exploring maths in everyday scenarios. With catchy songs and fun animation.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Visit a Castle
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit a ruined castle near the beach. JoJo imagines what the castle looked like before it was a ruin and finds it's just like being on a Captain Chloe adventure!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Camping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are going camping and they hear a scary noise outside the tent!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Boreal Forest, Canada

programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Ku is a skilled Kung Fu artist brought up by the bandits and does not agree with the brutal leader of the bandit's camp. He rescues Tong, a young lady forced to become the leader's wife, causing both the authorities and bandits to come after them. Ku has to stand up against the bandits that he grew up with so as to start a new life for himself.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - A House Divided
programme.desc: As the countdown to the Eternal Night approaches, Jim is enlightened in the truth about himself.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Jimhunters
programme.desc: When Jim's friends discover the Trollhunter has gone through a transformation, Jim will test his newly gained abilities.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Bout of the Beastly Barfilisk
programme.desc: Harold and George don't ask for much -- just a fun scavenger hunt that doesn't include doing Krupp's errands. Careful what you wish for, fellas.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Crystal Venom
programme.desc: The Castle of Lions mysteriously turns against the Paladins, forcing Princess Allura to make a difficult sacrifice to save Team Voltron.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Collection and Extraction
programme.desc: Team Voltron infiltrates a hidden Galra Space Station to investigate why Zarkon is attacking planets and siphoning the life energy from the universe

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Not-So-Secret Surprise
programme.desc: Lucky enlists Abigail Turo Snips and their horses to help plan a surprise birthday party for Pru that goes disastrously wrong

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hare Hops
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hare didn't hop. He was one of the speediest animals in Tinga Tinga but none of the other animals wanted to race with him because Hare always won and it was becoming boring. Then one day, slow but clever Tortoise decides to challenge Hare.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Mosquito Buzzes
programme.desc: You see there was time when Mosquito didn't buzz. Mosquito was as quiet as quiet can be… and did she like to tell tales. One day Mosquito tells the Monkeys that the sun looks very low in the sky. ‘Maybe it's sad and doesn't want to rise!' worry the Monkeys.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dodgems
programme.desc: Marsha decides to be a mechanic but wears Big Chris out with her endless questions. Disaster strikes when Chris dozes off and doesn't listen to her properly…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Tall Story Roary
programme.desc: The loudspeaker system is not working at Silver Hatch. How will Roary be stopped from performing a dangerous stunt on the track?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Car Boot Sale
programme.desc: Big Chris has a clear out and takes all his old junk up to Farmer Green's car boot sale but misses the clutter in Rusty. How will he get everything back?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hot Stuff
programme.desc: Big Chris takes the cars to the beach to relax in the heat but he is so busy dealing with the cars he forgets to drink his water. But hang on, who else has drunk it…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Law And Order
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is fed up with the cars running amok on his track and summons Bill and Nick to restore order to the track. But might our overzealous policeman overstep the mark?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash's Tea Party
programme.desc: Flash invites everyone to a tea party, thinking they bring the food with them. Are there going to be a lot of hungry bunnies at Silver hatch?

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Election
programme.desc: After he’s rescued from a cave, a charismatic old lemur challenges Julien to an election for the throne.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Daddy Julien
programme.desc: King Julien believes Mort is the son he never knew he had - despite the fact that Mort is two years older than him.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Disturbing Dilemma of the Dysfunctional Doppelgangers
programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgängers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confusing Crisis of the Conniving Captive
programme.desc: Melvin isn't exactly their friend ... but it's not like George and Harold can just let him be held captive by diabolical Biglyans, right? Right?!?

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Giant Haboob
programme.desc: Cleve Kelso breaks Rafaela Moreno and a dangerous, cybernetic prisoner named Matsuo Mori from a high-security ice prison. Back in LA, Tony and the crew experience a major shake-up when Echo gets accepted to Ms. Nowhere’s spy training but Tony is rejected. While Tony is grappling with his identity crisis, Echo struggles to survive spy school, and Ms. Nowhere and Gary disappear in a massive North African storm during their hunt for Cleve. Echo must lead the Toretto crew and finish Ms.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Dead End
programme.desc: The team travels to Nihaya, or "The Dead End," in their pursuit of Nowhere’s mission. Unfortunately they run into some of Layla’s spurned former criminal partner Sandocal, who steals the kids’ cars for revenge on Layla. programme.desc: The Dragon Riders discover a lush island that turns out to be the home of the Deathsong, a massive dragon that threatens to trap them forever.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - When Darkness Falls
programme.desc: On an island that will make the perfect outpost, the Dragon Riders discover its indigenous residents are a mysterious new breed of dragon.

programme.desc: When Jim is imprisoned in the Darklands, Blinky tries to decipher the Amulet to save him while Claire, Toby, and NotEnrique race to recover the Killahead Bridge before it's too late

programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Biscuits Rising
programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - The Depths
programme.desc: Lance and Hunk crash on a water planet and must rescue a mind-controlled mermaid civilization

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Shiro's Escape
programme.desc: The team sets off to a new planet where they hope to find information on Shiro's past

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Pie P.I.
programme.desc: Mysteries collide when horse thieves strike Miradero at the same time as a pie thief strikes the church bake sale while the adults try to keep the horse thieves at bay Lucky is determined to find out who stole the pies.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Lion Roars
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Lion had lost his roar. Crocodile was snapping at all the animals in the Waterhole and Lion opened his big mouth but nothing came out! Tiny Flea tells Lion that if he dares to enter the Great Cave of Tinga Tinga then maybe he will find his roar. Lion plucks up courage and goes into the Great Cave. He roars with all his might, but a bigger roar comes back! Lion stands strong. He roars again and an even bigger roar comes back.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Zebra Has Stripes
programme.desc: Zebra was once very easy to spot in Tinga Tinga as he was bright white all over. This very annoying as all he wanted was to be left alone to munch on yummy grass and get fat. One day, Eagle arrives at the Watering Hole with a new pair of sharp talons saying that she found them in the Great Cave. The animals excitedly rush to find something for themselves. Zebra accompanies Tortoise and the Monkeys into the Cave where they discover the last remaining item; a plain black coat.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Funny Business

programme.desc: Ellie &amp; the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers. When Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lil must save him! Eager to become Master Criminals, Lil &amp; Jack help Chuck with his "dirty laundry". But are they ready for a life of crime?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Lost in Bikini Bottom Tutor Sauce
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to take a shortcut to work, but becomes lost along the way. After failing his driver's test again, Mr. Krabs decides to teach SpongeBob how to drive himself.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Squid Plus One The Executive Treatment
programme.desc: After receiving an invitation to a gallery opening, Squidward scrambles to find a friend to take with him. While trying to order a special sandwich, Patrick gets swept up in the fast paced world of business.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 - Pat-per Route Day of the Dartfish
programme.desc: Patrick helps Squidward with his newspaper delivery job to compensate for injuring him. In the midst of a typical day of scavenging, the Dartfish family discovers a thief in the Star home.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 - Jade the Juggler Parcel Chase
programme.desc: Jade tries to help too many people and ends up causing chaos in the process! The Twins ask the Marsupilamis to wait for an important parcel, but they miss it, so try and retrieve it from the depot.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - Along Came a Sister Chore and Peace
programme.desc: Lincoln is given the responsibility of taking home his classes' tarantula, but it gets loose and wreaks havoc! Thinking he has the worst chores, Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores with him.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - For Bros About to Rock It's a Loud, Loud, Loud, Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln is going to his first rock concert, and Luna is determined to make it the greatest experience ever. Lincoln finds a letter in the attic leading him to believe there is money hidden within the Loud house!

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - Toads and Tiaras Two Boys and a Baby
programme.desc: After Lola gets sick and can't compete in her pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place. Thinking it'll be easy, Lincoln and Clyde take on the task of babysitting the youngest Loud, Lily.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 - Cover Girls Save the Date
programme.desc: When all 10 of Lincoln's sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day, Lincoln has his hands full. Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - Party All The Crime
programme.desc: After Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one. When Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 - Thundercover
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission to Secret Shores so she can experience life as a normal kid. When a new supervillain threat emerges, the trio must stay in town longer than they anticipated.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - New School Who Dis?
programme.desc: After Schwoz's experiment-gone-wrong causes an infestation at Sw.A.G, Danger Force enrolls at Swellview Junior High and stumbles into an extra-curricular crime wave.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Class Action Heroes
programme.desc: Danger Force is crushing it at Swellview Junior High, but Ray misses his sidekicks and schemes to get them out of school.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - A Tale of Two Pipers
programme.desc: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future. When a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, The Gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Captain Mom
programme.desc: Captain Man is being a baby about having a baby. Labor pains leave him helpless so Kid Danger and Piper step up to take on a couple of slick grease thieves.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Bishop Makes Her Move
programme.desc: The origin of the woman called BISHOP! Why does she hate mutants? What is the secret of the Mechazoids? And exactly what happened the night the Turtles fell into Bishop's trap?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Night Of The Mechazoids
programme.desc: The Turtles take the fight to Bishop but she's ready for them... get ready for MECHA-BIHSOP! But when the Mechazoids go out of control, can the Turtles save humanity?

programme.title: The Loud House S6 - Space Jammed Crown and Dirty
programme.desc: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space. Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a Mother-Daughter pageant.

programme.title: The Loud House S6 - Pop Pop the Question Lynn and Order
programme.desc: When the kids discover Myrtle has a shady past, they try to expose her before Pop Pop proposes. Lynn and Liam butt heads when they're forced to partner up as the middle school hall monitors.

programme.title: The Loud House S4 - Any Given Sundae
programme.desc: Lily hears the parents mention ice cream if the kids are good, so she uses baby smarts to avert sibling disasters.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S2 - The Real Woori World The Collector
programme.desc: Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favorite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Best Summer Ever?
programme.desc: Jack &amp; Lily are half-siblings living on opposite ends of the world both hoping to have the "best summer ever." When dangerous events forces Jack's mom to send him to live with his dad, the kids fear their summer dreams have become a nightmare.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 - Zoo U A Remembrance of Grand-Past
programme.desc: The Star family goes on a college tour for Patrick... at the zoo. GrandPat shares his life stories to spoil every movie at the theater.

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP3
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Brick Slaves - EP13
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work.

programme.title: The Runner - EP23
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP9
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP8
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP8
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP3
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP2
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Legend Of Master Chai - EP15
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers._x000D__x000D_Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen.

programme.title: 同学早安第18集
programme.desc: 在家乡玉里服务一辈子的老师「杨招治」 人生幸福组的她却在年过半百时，失去挚爱的丈夫，面临退休与否的抉择。 「人生只能这样吗？」招治问自己。她想起家中的三老，她看见生活周遭需要帮助的灵魂，那些需要触动了招治最温柔的一块心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是这样…

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第1集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第493集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第27集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6748集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 水返脚的春天第18集
programme.desc: 「水返脚」，就是现今「汐止」。当静芬见到山田，才知道他们在这山区住了二十年，却没见过对方。心宽念纯的静芬，人生的功课，包括：勇敢的拥抱养母说出爱；调柔一丝不苟固执的山田；小学毕业程度却能参加笔耕队，写作盲人与退伍老兵的感人文章登载于报纸，她的心路历程，见证了单纯能提升正面向上的力量。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第4集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大马慈济情第701集
programme.desc: 节目内容为马来西亚当地时事以及慈济人的报导，透过这些具有启发性的报导、爱的讯息，带领观众深入人文道理，见证慈悲等人文知识，进一步带领观众启发善念，净化人心。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第29集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.desc: 你我的生活小问号，可能成就科学大发现。所以号召全民try科学，活化每个人潜在的科学基因。 生鸡蛋握掌心，为什么连壮汉都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎么打开没拉环的易开罐？ 科学基因不限男女老幼贫富贵贱，科学现象不分校园、街头、办公室或客厅，Try科学想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科学以放大生活中各种有趣现象为诱因，以主持人科学机智问答的闯关设计，透过科学MAN吸引眼球的科学实验与找答案的逻辑推理……让科学接地气，让科学活用在生活里。

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第52集

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第29集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第28集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 庆余年第27集
programme.desc: 某大学文学史专业的学生张庆（张若昀饰）熟读古典名著，但他用现代观念剖析古代文学史，透过写小说的方式，进一步阐述自己想要表达的观点。在他的小说中，身世神秘的少年范闲，自小跟随奶奶生活在海边小城澹州，随著一位自称老师的突然造访，他看似平静的生活开始直面重重的危机与考验。上半部的剧情主要发生在京都，范闲追查牛栏街刺杀一案的幕后黑手。下半部剧情发生在北齐上京城，范闲亲率南庆使团，前往北齐用战犯肖恩交换言冰云。但这只是，庆帝和陈萍萍布局，想令肖恩误以为范闲就是他失散多年的孙子，借此套出神庙的秘密。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第629集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第47集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第13集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.title: MIT台湾志第630集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第1948集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第49集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第14集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.title: 包青天第44集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 幸福蜜方第1集
programme.desc: 主角庄孝廉，大学助理教授，因学校经营不善而遭解职。孝廉原想找到新工作后，再将其离开教职状况告知家人，怎奈妻子的一场升职庆祝会上，一通面试通知电话，让他失业窘境当众被发现。孝廉四处找工作，一个个面试主管问他到底生活应用科学系在教甚么，孝廉一次次认真回答，却一次次石沉大海，原来中年转业是如此困难。有一天，电视名女主持人菲菲走进他家，说要来做「玉脂凝露泡泡澡」，孝廉怒责妻子连这么私密的家庭活动都邀外人来，只听妻子反道，菲菲是不能得罪的贵宾，要孝廉好好招待她，没想到因此改变了孝廉的命运…

programme.title: 两场葬礼第1集
programme.desc: (2019)林道雄（游安顺饰）自小被过继给远房林姓亲戚，在另一个家庭长大。生父因经济因素将他过继，养母因丈夫决定收养林道雄，但看到他就像提醒自己膝下只有女无子。在两家都不受待见的林道雄在长大成人后便独自出走生活，在一间套房出租旅馆当管理员。世事荒诞而无常，多年后，林道雄同时接到了生父与养母的讣告，两边家庭成员因各自的理由又重新找上了他。

programme.title: 健康新煮流系列第52集

programme.title: 大自然生趣第32集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 全球致命气候第6季:第13集

programme.title: 追谜探险队第7季:第15集
programme.desc: 在解开摩西之谜的最后一段旅程，乔许到一座绿松石矿坑遗址得知字母的起源、挖掘埋藏在遗迹下的历史证据，并到加利利海寻找藏在水中的神秘结构，这一切最终引导他抵达了摩西的墓前。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第1集
programme.desc: 德鲁与堤伊远赴法国搜刮旧货，目标是盖尔文化古董、花园家具、艺术品、装饰品，以及灯具等等好货。他们逛世界最大的跳蚤市场，会见资深古董商，参加盛大的年度古董展览，最后还拜访修复中的古堡。每一回合德鲁都狠狠杀价，最后满载而归。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 德鲁在某个谷仓里找到一辆奇怪的小车，这似乎是某人自己手工组装的小汽车，德鲁动用两名修复师，克雷格负责座椅，波海尔负责修复引擎，让这辆小车能够再度上路。艾利克斯这次又接了一位新旧货商的案子，东尼找到一个共济会集会所里的橱柜，但因为从墙上拆下时，柜体造成了损坏，必须靠艾利克斯把它修复，让这个秘密橱柜重获新生。

programme.title: 蛮野一家第6季:第2集
programme.desc: 蛮野一家面临史上最大挑战：大自然的重大灾害。原本即将迎来工程完结的喜悦，突如其来的野火，让布朗家族乱了方寸。毁灭性的天然灾害，来得又急又快，无法顾及一切，只能庆幸全家人平安逃离。火势扑灭后，狼群回到原本的家园检视损失情形，巡视一片狼藉的惨状，恒久家园的梦想是否还能继续？蛮野一家将共同决定未来的方向。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第2季:第5集

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 在苦寻二十年后，麦克终于找到一辆稀有的福特二代跑天下，尽管无锈蚀的车壳看似完美，其余部分却惨不忍睹。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第2集

programme.title: 西班牙海港护卫队第1季:第5集

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集德鲁东奔西跑，前往三个特别地点搜寻奇特旧货。首先是一间旧肥皂工厂，他在此找到了工业风家具和稀奇肥皂模具。接著拜访曾往来过的古董商「炼金术之家」，买走了几件女主人的宝贝藏品和一幅有可能是波兰著名画家真迹的复制画。最后在一场以古怪为主题的拍卖会得标几件怪奇艺品。德鲁对这周搜奇成果十分满意。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第15季:第7集
programme.desc: 德鲁和堤伊到了西索美赛特铁路博物馆、乌斯特、北汉普顿寻宝，这次的主题是找一些背后有故事的古老物件。古董若有背景故事支持，甚至能查到前主人的身份、居住地点等资讯，能为古董大大地加分。他们在铁路博物馆看到世界仅存的某型火车车厢，并买下古老的车站标示，又在乌斯特、北汉普顿买到各种老件，它们穿越历史，饱经风霜，受到极少、或可修复的损坏，留存到现在。

programme.title: 单挑求生高手第3季:第2集

programme.title: 原始生活21天西班牙版第1季:第6集

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 在苦寻二十年后，麦克终于找到一辆稀有的福特二代跑天下，尽管无锈蚀的车壳看似完美，其余部分却惨不忍睹。

programme.title: 战痘医师第4季:第2集
programme.desc: 鲁本的后脑勺长了大肿块，严重影响自信，因害怕出门被人盯著看而不再和女儿外出，连健身教练的工作都变成线上教学，大大影响生活。

programme.title: 秘境厨房第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾琳一口气雇用了八名新人加入秘境厨房的团队，非常担心新团队是否能够像过去一样合作无间，让秘境厨房充满一贯的魔力。其中最让艾琳担心的就是新加入的厨师伊莎，因为她要接替的是艾琳在厨房里最得力的副手克莉丝塔的位置，这个位置需要和艾琳有绝佳的默契，否则难保会出现碰撞或火烧厨房的危机。还好在第一次晚餐过后，伊莎用行动证明艾琳的担心都是多余的，也为秘境厨房第九年营业季带来一个美好的开始。

programme.title: 修复英式庄园第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 跟随建筑师迪恩波顿Dean Poulton与设计师博贾马夸Borja de Maqua，看他们亲手修复一座曾属于亨利七世国王、历经三百年岁月洗礼的英式庄园。这座曾经宏伟却日渐破败的皇家遗迹，在两人的巧思与工艺下，从中世纪风格重生，蜕变成梦幻庄园。

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第10集

programme.title: 面子问题第1季:第5集

programme.title: 秘境厨房第3季:第4集
programme.desc: 秘境厨房通过了第一次晚餐的考验后，艾琳对自己的新团队感到非常有信心，决定想一些新的菜色当作自我挑战，但又不想一下子挑战太难的事情，搞得大家手忙脚乱，于是就从甜点开始做一点小改变。艾琳和凯莉从新摘的洋甘菊得到灵感，想做洋甘菊口味的意式奶冻，但不知为何，两人在冬天研发的完美奶冻食谱却一直出错，艾琳只好再次临时更换甜点，用她最自豪的姜糖司康代替。
